remarks: Experience the best of Connecticut coastal living in an environmentally sustainable and stylish package! Energy-efficient, European-inspired home blends the best of urban and coastal lifestyles, tucked away in a friendly, tree-lined neighborhood with plenty of yard space for privacy and fun. Wake up with the sun rising over the harbor, and take your morning coffee on your private deck, watching the oyster boats while listening to the osprey, seabirds, and songbirds begin their morning routines. Every morning is a new tapestry of color. Tune into nature's rhythms and take advantage of 8 total hours of high tide: your kayak and paddle boards await. Paddle over to swim off Peach Island, just minutes away. Or if city life draws you, explore downtown SONO's excellent restaurants and eateries - not to mention its live music, art, culture and oyster festivals - all just a mile away. Need to commute to NYC or New Haven for work, or want to visit their countless cultural opportunities? Highway 95 and MetroNorth's direct train to Grand Central are just a 5-minute's drive, and parking is easy. Come home after a long day, enjoy a cool drink as you put your feet up on the lounge deck, check out what's blooming in the garden, watch the setting sun set the harbor aglow as you grill up something special.
